description: This file defines the Reminder class for the SuiteCRM system. It manages reminder data, including creating, saving, loading, and notifying about reminders associated with calendar events like Meetings and Calls. The class handles reminders' configurations, recurring upgrade logic, and integrations for notifications like popups and emails.

classes.name: Reminder
classes.description: Represents reminders associated with calendar events in SuiteCRM, providing methods to manage, load, save, upgrade, and notify reminders.

methods.name: saveRemindersDataJson
methods.description: Decodes JSON reminders data and saves multiple reminders related to an event module and ID.

methods.name: saveRemindersData
methods.description: Saves each reminder object into the database, handling duplicates, and deleting related alerts and invitees.

methods.name: loadRemindersDataJson
methods.description: Loads multiple reminders as a JSON string for a specific event.

methods.name: loadRemindersData
methods.description: Loads reminders data for a specific event module and ID, caching the results.

methods.name: sendEmailReminders
methods.description: Sends email reminders for all unsent reminders, marking them as sent after successful dispatch.

methods.name: addNotifications
methods.description: Generates popup and desktop notifications for upcoming reminders, managing integrated meetings and alert timings.

methods.name: makeAlertURL
methods.description: Constructs URL for detailed view of an event given its module and record ID.

methods.name: unQuoteTime
methods.description: Removes single-quote characters from a time string.

methods.name: isDecline
methods.description: Checks whether a person has declined an event based on accept status.

methods.name: testEventPersonAcceptStatus
methods.description: Tests if the event-person accept status matches a given string, such as 'decline'.

methods.name: getEventPersonAcceptStatus
methods.description: Retrieves accept status values for a person related to an event.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade routines, migrating user preferences and event reminders from old formats.

methods.name: getRemindersListView
methods.description: Returns the HTML for displaying the list of reminders related to an event.
